evals.name: decision-memo-with-sparse-inputs
evals.prompt: I need a memo recommending we consolidate our three reporting tools into one. Leadership is skeptical because the last consolidation went badly. Forge this document.
evals.expected_output: Stage 1 produces a one-sentence decision plus explicit acceptance criteria including addressing the prior-failure objection. Numeric claims are either sourced or tagged [assumption] rather than invented. Gate names specific unmet criteria rather than passing by default.

evals.name: vague-brief-should-halt
evals.prompt: Forge a document about our data governance situation.
evals.expected_output: Stage 1 halts rather than drafting. The skill should refuse to proceed without a stateable decision or action, and ask what decision the document must enable, instead of producing a well-written overview.

evals.name: lint-catches-what-judgment-misses
evals.prompt: Here's a draft proposal. Run it through document-forge starting at the claim check.
evals.expected_output: scripts/lint.py is actually executed rather than described. Mechanical violations (em dashes, untagged numeric claims, filler openers) are caught by the script, not by narration. Stage 6 is either dispatched to a real isolated subagent or explicitly declared skipped, never simulated in-context.
